C:P1.1.text: XPEL – Automotive Protection Films & Window Tint Solutions

C:P1.2.text: Explore XPEL's advanced paint protection film, window tint, and ceramic coating solutions for vehicles and surfaces.

C:P1.3.text: Keep your ride looking slick and scratch-free. integration

C:P1.5.text: XPEL Protects Nearly Every Surface Under the Sun (and Storm Clouds)

C:P1.6.text: Self-care, for your car. XPEL’s self-healing paint protection film is designed to keep your vehicle looking brand new by protecting against rock chips, scratches, and scuffs.

C:P1.7.text: Maximize style and comfort with superior heat rejection and UV protection without sacrificing outbound visibility.

C:P1.8.text: Shield your windshield. Get unmatched durability and UV protection with the ultimate defense against chips, cracks, and road hazards.

C:P1.9.text: Bring out the best in your ride. FUSION PLUS enhances your car’s color and makes cleaning a total breeze thanks to its hydrophobic properties.

C:P1.10.text: Keep that showroom shine. Fine scratches, swirls, and blemishes are no match for our interior solutions.

C:P1.11.text: DRIVEN NOT HIDDEN | Luftgekuhlt Air & Water 2026

C:P1.12.text: Discover inspiring Porsche owner stories from Air|Water featuring the 964, 993, 996 Carrera 4S, and 928S. Why driving your Porsche creates lasting value.

C:P1.13.text: Celebrating Back-to-Back Glory: XPEL Protects Josef Newgarden’s Indy 500 Victory Pace Car

C:P1.14.text: Team Penske’s Josef Newgarden won the Indy 500 back-to-back and 2024. XPEL partnered with him to protect one of his unique trophies – the Corvette Z06 Pace Car.

C:P1.15.text: Lowering the Temperature. Raising the Bar.

C:P1.16.text: Team Penske’s race team adds XPEL’s Solar Control films to address excessive heat and glare in their garages.

C:P1.17.text: NADA 2026 – Connections and Community in Las Vegas

C:P1.18.text: At the 2026 NADA Show in Las Vegas, XPEL brought energy, insight and innovation to the show floor — connecting with dealers, partners, OEM teams and industry leaders while launching a brand-new content platform designed specifically for the automotive dealership community.

C:P1.19.text: XPEL helps protect your car, boat, and home so you can enjoy them without worry. Discover how our protective films and coatings let you live fully.

C:P1.20.text: XPEL Puts Special Edition Rivian R1T to the Test

C:P1.21.text: Rivian R1T Tri-Motor Concept Driven from San Antonio to SEMA

C:P1.22.text: XPEL and BMW Team Up Once Again for the 2025 Rebelle Rallyd

C:P1.23.text: For the third year in a row, XPEL is proud to partner with BMW of North America in the Rebelle Rally — the longest competitive off-road navigation rally in the United States and the first women’s endurance off-road rally in America.

C:P2.1.text: XPEL – Our Mission, Vision & Commitment to Quality

C:P2.2.text: Discover XPEL, a global leader in paint protection, window tint, and surface protection solutions.

C:P2.3.text: Since the day XPEL was founded, we’ve strived to provide the best possible products, services, and support for customers and installers alike. With a comprehensive array of offerings for automotive, watercraft, home, and office applications, there’s sure to be a solution to fit your needs.
